raw.source: US BIS — Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms and related parts. For China-origin or China-routed shipments into the US market, exporters should re-verify the current USML/CCL classification (EAR Category 0 vs. ITAR), confirm whether a BIS license or license exception now applies, and re-map the 10-digit HTS line against Section 301 lists and any firearms-specific tariff actions. Screen all parties against the Entity List, SDN, and denied-party lists, and retain end-use/end-user statements. Note that the rescission affects US export controls, not US import rules (ATF Form 6/5330.3, 27 CFR 478/479) — import permits and marking requirements remain in force.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，放宽了民用枪支及相关零部件的许可与分类处理。对于输美或经中国转运的货物，出口商应重新核实当前的 USML/CCL 分类（EAR 第 0 类与 ITAR 的区分），确认是否适用 BIS 许可或许可例外，并将 10 位 HTS 编码重新对照 301 条款清单及枪支专项关税措施。须对交易各方进行实体清单、SDN 及被拒绝人员名单筛查，并留存最终用途/最终用户声明。注意：本次撤销仅影响美国出口管制，不影响美国进口规则（ATF Form 6/5330.3、27 CFR 478/479）——进口许可与标识要求仍然有效。

checklist.desc: Confirm whether the firearm or part falls under ITAR USML Category I/II or EAR CCL Category 0, and document the classification rationale after the rule rescission.
Determine whether a BIS export license or a license exception (e.g., ENC, RPL, or firearms-specific exception) now applies; record the basis in the export file.
Map the 10-digit HTS line for the firearm/part, check Section 301 lists and firearms-specific tariff actions, and document country of origin and value build-up.
Screen consignee, end-user, and intermediaries against the BIS Entity List, OFAC SDN, and denied-party lists; retain end-use/end-user statements.
Confirm ATF Form 6 / 5330.3 import permit, marking, and 27 CFR 478/479 requirements remain satisfied for US-bound firearms.
Verify lead-content, ammunition, and hazardous-material restrictions applicable to firearm components under US federal and state environmental rules.
